summary: First real-game whole-backbuffer D3D9 ColorFill can establish a native D3D11 Draw color seed without a prior TARGET Clear only after proven RT0/backbuffer identity, game device provenance, geometry, physical format, no-MSAA and untouched source call epoch. Native output/runtime UNTESTED. D3D9 fallback and post-Draw source overwrite abort remain unchanged.

All unowned, incompatible, clipped, MSAA or nonpristine draw sequences retain unchanged DX9Ex.
Original D3D9 HRESULT/Draw/Present/input/FFB preserved, no fake first visible frame.
Five mandatory GitHub Actions pass exact last material target HEAD.

canonical game backbuffer and first native color seed
real game D3D9 Draw observer -> D3D11 native Draw
